Refinement ratio 1.5 per axis, 2.25 in cells

budget_v1_3.macro_weight_note: W = 6e4 / 2.25 = 26 666.7: the same macro-particles per cell as the v2 base (the grid-refinement study keeps the particle resolution per cell fixed, so the total macro-particle count scales x2.25: ~2.25 M e- + 2.25 M Xe+ at the v2 plateau density 2.13e17 mean); the seed 5e16 m^-3 gives 643 k per species at t = 0
budget_v1_3.n_eq_projected_over_n_max: 0.28-0.8 (attempt 2, n_g0 = 5.5e19: 0.58 at the nu_iz tau = 1 fixed point)

claim_boundary: none: shakedown only (early CEX / MEX event rates and the exit-plane IEDF shape at 100k steps = 0.14 us, compared with the legacy set's plateau IEDF of 0d228ad2 as a shape reference, are reported as readings, not results)
classification: development shakedown of model v2.5.0 (neutrals_spatial_v1 + metastables_v1) on the ss-v4 33 um protocol with xe_collision_set_v2; 100k steps; early readings only

cross_sections.note: selected through operating_point.collision_set; the hashes are recomputed from the files at load and enter config_sha256 (a protocol cannot declare data it does not ship)

geometry.source: P2 mesh regions injector-zone/channel-straight/channel-divergent-exit of divergent-exit-stack.level-1; unchanged from v2

neutral_model_shakedown_note: 100k steps = 0.14 us of plasma time: the neutral field is the initial Knudsen profile minus the first depletion (14 us of neutral time), the plasma is still the seed transient; the readings (axis profile, where the ionisation sits, metastable fraction, sub-step cost) are early, not a result

numerics.averaging_window_note: consecutive 400000-step (0.56 us at 1.4 ps) windows; the reported maps are the last completed window (or the current one if at least half full); the v2.0.3 gates read the same 400000-step window
numerics.checkpoint_note: checkpoint-latest.{json,npz} rewritten atomically every 40000 steps (56 ns); n_g and the atom ledgers are in the checkpoint arrays; series.jsonl / status.jsonl appended at every 200-step sync
numerics.dt_justification: 1.4 ps (v2: 1.5 ps): omega_pe dt at the v2 window peak 1.64e18 m^-3 is 0.101 (0.108 at 1.5 ps; gate 0.2); the attempt-8 resolution analysis asked dt <= 1.48 ps for omega_pe dt <= 0.16 (20 % under the gate) at the plume peak 3.7e18 - adopted here so the refinement also has time-step margin; electron Courant at 400 eV: 1.19e7 m/s x 1.4 ps = 16.6 um = 0.50 cells of 33.3 um (gate 1 cell); omega_ce dt at the channel max |B| 0.291 T: 0.072. Step-count conversions: 200-step series interval = 0.28 ns, 40000-step checkpoint = 56 ns, 400000-step window = 0.56 us, one ion transit (2.4 us) = 1 714 286 steps, 3 transits = 5 142 858 steps
numerics.frame_recorder_note: v2.0 frame recorder ON (28 ns frames = exact interval averages from the window accumulators; ~1.8 MB/frame uncompressed on the 91 x 721 node grid; 3 transits = 257 frames ~0.25-0.45 GB compressed): the first frames of a channel-only steady-state run (the v2 plateau has none), for the resolution comparison of the ionisation structure at the cusp planes and for a video; frames are diagnostics, not gates
numerics.neutral_update_note: v2.5.0: the neutral particles are sub-cycled every operating_point.neutrals.substep_steps = 200 PIC steps (= device_sync_steps); the electron and ion MCC read the published per-cell density (device-resident) every step

peak_debye_gate.max_cells_per_debye_note: v2.0.3 window-mode gate (spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v2.0.json gates_v2_0.peak_debye_gate_v2_0_3): the gated statistic is max(dr, dz) / lambda_D at the densest node of the trailing 400000-step (0.56 us) interval average among nodes with mean occupancy >= 32 macro-electrons, with the window's moment T_e (the maps.npz construction). HARD pi (the Birdsall-Langdon CIC finite-grid-instability threshold; plume attempt 8 heated from ~3.2, the v2 base plateau sat at 3.17), fail-closed once the window is complete. SOFT 2.5 (20 % margin) is a plateau precondition (plateau.peak_debye_soft_ok), never a stop. Expected here: the v2 base peak 1.64e18 m^-3 / 7.39 eV gives lambda_D 15.8 um -> 33.3 um / 15.8 um = 2.11 (a 16 % margin to the soft level; the soft level is reached if the resolved peak densifies by 40 % at fixed T_e, e.g. 2.3e18 at 7.4 eV, or cools to 5.3 eV at 1.64e18); the hard level needs 3.6e18 at 7.4 eV. A plateau above 2.5 is recorded as 'resolution margin not met' (acceptance (a) fails, run continues to the budget) - a legitimate outcome, not a defect.
peak_debye_gate.min_macro_particles_at_peak_note: mean occupancy over the window; the v2 peak node (14, 286) held ~300 macro-electrons per step at W 6e4 (node volume 1.1e-11 m^3); at W 2.667e4 on the 33.3 um grid the corresponding node (r 0.7 mm: volume 2pi r dr dz = 4.9e-12 m^3) holds ~300 as well (same particles per cell); axis nodes (volume pi (dr/2)^2 dz / ... ~ 1e-14 m^3) stay below the floor

numerics.poisson: device block-Thomas direct (exact to round-off, true-residual contract 1e-10 |rhs| verified at every host sync)
numerics.step_graph_note: v1.4 CUDA-graph step (bitwise-identical to the direct launches; tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_warp_parity.py)

collision_set.collision_set_note: R3 (audit gaps e1 + e4): four Biagi-v7.1 excitation levels with per-level energy loss instead of the lumped 8.32 eV channel; Xe+ - Xe charge exchange (Miller 2002) and momentum transfer (Phelps isotropic) per ion sub-step against the inventory density with a Maxwellian atom at neutral_temperature_k; CEX fast neutrals leaving through the exit aperture drain the inventory and carry thrust (fast_neutral_thrust_n); ion_neutral: true selects both processes with the default table grid (0.05 eV to 2000 eV) and fast-neutral speed threshold 4 sqrt(kT_g/M)
collision_set.name: xe_collision_set_v2

operating_point.electron_injection_justification: kept from v1.2: v2 ignited from this injection at 1e20 and the v1.2 reference did not at 1.5e19 (beam mirrored back); attempt 1 at 5e19 with the 1e16 seed also did not ignite (91-96 % of the beam returned), so attempt 2 changes the seed, not the injection
operating_point.neutral_density_role: MCC null-collision ceiling n_g0 ONLY (v2.5.0 neutrals_spatial_v1): the initial Knudsen profile of the ss-v4 feed peaks at 5.5e20 m^-3 on the anode face (10 x the exit density 5.5e19 = Q_in / c for the 2 mm bore / 3 mm exit), so the ceiling is raised from the 0-D protocol's 5.5e19 to 1e21 (5.5 sigma of the ~13 % per-cell deposit noise at ~60 macro-neutrals per cell) - the published density is clamped there and the run fails closed only if more than max_ceiling_violation_fraction of the plasma cell-substeps of an interval are clamped; the instantaneous density is the published per-cell field of the neutral particles
operating_point.neutral_model_note: v2.5.0: operating_point.neutrals (neutrals_spatial_v1 + metastables_v1) REPLACES operating_point.neutral_inventory of the ss-v4 protocol; the removed 0-D block was feed 8.551e16 /s, tau_g 30 ns, wall recycling at 500 K (kept as the spatial model's feed / T_w / recycling)

neutrals.feed_note: the ss-v4 feed Q_in = 8.551e16 atoms/s (0.01864 mg/s), unchanged: the SPATIAL model at this feed carries a channel-mean density 4-5 x the 0-D fixed point (see the v2.5.0 spec) - this shakedown exercises the code path, it does not re-declare the operating point
neutrals.macro_weight_note: ~8.7e13 atoms in the channel at the Knudsen profile -> ~4.0 M macro-neutrals (~60 per 33 um cell); 800 x the ion macro weight 26666.7
neutrals.max_ceiling_violation_fraction_note: declared tolerance of the clamp: the nearest-cell deposit has ~1/sqrt(N_cell) shot noise, so rare excursions above the ceiling are unavoidable; 1e-3 of the cell-substeps per interval

metastables.branching_note: metastable share of the Biagi-v7.1 levels 8.315 / 9.447 / 9.917 / 11.7 eV (spec v2.5.0 derivation; x3 uncertain)

neutrals.substep_note: one neutral sub-step per device sync interval (0.28 ns of plasma time)
neutrals.time_acceleration_note: DECLARED artificial acceleration (the spatial analogue of the 0-D tau_g = 30 ns): neutral time = 100 x plasma time, so the 100k-step shakedown covers 14 us of neutral time (~7 % of the tube residence V / c ~ 0.2 ms); only the fixed point is physical

operating_point.seed_justification: ATTEMPT 2: the seed used by the v1 and v2 snapshots (5e16 m^-3, 5 eV; 286 k macro-particles per species at W = 6e4), which ignited at 1e20 with the beam fully absorbed from the first 100 ns (exit return 0.9 -> 0.26 mA, anode 3.2-3.6 mA, nu_iz 2.8-4.2e6 s^-1, T_e rising 8 -> 10 eV). Attempt 1 used 1e16 and the seed cooled (T_e 7.9 -> 5.0 eV) with nu_iz falling 1.16e6 -> 5.6e5 s^-1 and 91-96 % of the beam mirroring back; a 5x denser seed builds the plasma potential structure that traps the beam electrons (the beam-transmission jump between 5e19 and 1e20 was 23x in ionisations per injected electron, far more than the 2x in collisionality, pointing at the potential structure rather than the collision rate). The seed is a documented initial condition, not a sustained source: it is not replenished
operating_point.unchanged_note: EVERY operating-point key is bit-for-bit the v2 attempt-2 value (300 V, 0 V exit, n_g0 5.5e19, feed 8.551e16 /s, tau_g 30 ns, exit-plane injection 3 mA @ 2 eV, seed 5e16 m^-3 @ 5 eV, cold ions); the refinement changes the grid, the time step and the macro-weight only

preregistration.coordinator: the R3 campaign (channel-33 + plume-v2.1 comparisons against 0d228ad2 with predeclared expectations, pic2d-model-v2.3.json) is scheduled by the coordinator, not here
preregistration.status: NONE - this directory exists for the 100 000-step box shakedown of the new collision set through finalize + assess; it is not a preregistered experiment and produces no result

convergence_pair.use: the particle-resolution band of the 50 um plateau: I_d/S/n_g within ~5 %, peak n_e / T_e,peak within ~12 %; the convergence tolerances below are 2x these bands

reference_run.grid: 60 x 480 cells, 50 x 50 um, dt 1.5 ps, W 6e4
reference_run.plateau: 3.2 transits (7.68 us, 5.12 M steps, 2.8 h), stop plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times; window [4.8 M, 5.12 M] steps

simplifications: neutrals: 0-D quasi-steady inventory, uniform in space (no neutral flow field, no local depletion where the ionisation is, no wall accommodation); feed prescribed, exit-plane thermal effusion at 300 K; the transient toward the fixed point is artificial (tau_g = 30 ns vs the physical 221 us) and only the fixed point is physical
no ion-neutral collisions (elastic or charge exchange)
electron-neutral: isotropic elastic without the 2 m_e/M energy loss, one lumped 8.32 eV excitation, single ionisation with Vahedi-Surendra secondary energy and isotropic emission
dielectric wall: perfectly absorbing with accumulated surface charge, zero field in the dielectric backing (perfect insulator), no secondary electron emission, no sputtering
exit plane: Dirichlet 0 V cathode/neutraliser reference; electrons injected there as a flux-weighted half-Maxwellian at fixed current
anode: perfectly absorbing conductor at fixed potential
cone wall represented as a one-cell stair-step of the plasma cell mask
prescribed static B from the P2 solution (no plasma-induced field); bilinear node interpolation of the C1 bicubic psi field
ions pushed every 8 steps with 8 dt (frozen in between; births added to the ion charge immediately)
electrostatic only, azimuthally symmetric: no azimuthal instabilities/anomalous transport
momentum-conserving bilinear scheme: energy is not exactly conserved; the ledger (with electrode work) residual is reported; a resume restarts the interval ledger

3 mA injection at 0.017 mg/s feed: a real CFT runs at 0.1-1 A and 0.1-1 mg/s; the self-consistent fixed point of the ionisation-depletion balance, not the absolute current or flow, is the object of this run
development/screening run: not preregistered, no experimental validation, not a performance prediction

single seed and a single refined grid (90 x 720, W 2.667e4): the comparison with the 60 x 480 / W 6e4 base plateau is a two-point grid-refinement check at fixed particles per cell, not a convergence sequence; grid and particle-weight effects are entangled at the ~5 % level (convergence pair)
preregistered resolution-convergence study of a development model: no experimental validation, not a performance prediction

v2.5.0 neutrals_spatial_v1: collisionless free-molecular neutrals (Kn >> 1), diffuse walls at T_w with alpha = 1 (unmeasured for BN / Al2O3), nearest-cell density deposit, time acceleration F = 100 (artificial; the fixed point is what is physical), no neutraliser gas

v2.5.0 metastables_v1: one 6s pool at 8.315 eV (J = 0 metastable folded in), declared branching, BEB stepwise cross section (low end of the literature bracket), superelastic by detailed balance, resonance levels not pooled

acceptance.a_plateau: stop_reason == plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times under the rule above (>= 3 transits, trailing-20 % drifts of I_d, N_e, n_g < 5 %, triad soft bounds, peak-Debye soft margin 2.5)
acceptance.b_residual_power: summary.grid_heating_triad.windowed_energy_residual_over_electrode_work (the trailing 400000-step ratio at the stop) < +0.02 (heating side, one-sided; the accepted 50 um runs read -0.2 % / -1.5 % / -4.2 % - the negative side is reported, not judged) - i.e. the refined run is itself free of grid heating at the 2 % level

c_convergence_tolerances.note: relative |v4 - v2| / |v2| on the trailing-20 % / window quantities (I_d, I_beam: summary.window_currents_a; S, utilisation, n_g: summary.neutral_inventory trailing means; peak n_e and T_e,peak: the window maps at the densest node); tolerances = 2x the particle-resolution band of the 50 um convergence pair (I_d 5.7 %, S 4.6 %, n_g 4.0 %, peak n_e 11.9 %, T_e,peak 9.3 %); the refinement changes W with the grid (fixed particles per cell), so grid and particle effects are entangled at the 5 % level - a W-only variant at 50 um (W = 2.667e4) is the declared follow-up if (c) fails

d_reclassification.converged: (a) AND (b) AND every (c) tolerance met -> the 50 um base plateau is 'resolution-converged at the 10 % (I_d, S, n_g) / 20 % (peak n_e, T_e,peak) level'; the v2 numbers may be quoted with these bands
d_reclassification.no_plateau: NOT (a): budget stop / gate stop / soft-margin block -> 'inconclusive at 33 um within 24 h' with the stop reason, the trailing drifts and the trailing-window quantities reported; a resume is a new session under the same identity (disclosed), never a re-preregistration
d_reclassification.refinement_heating: (a) but NOT (b) -> the 33 um run itself heats above 2 % of the electrode work: the comparison is not a convergence test; the peak-Debye reading and residual are reported and a finer grid or lower operating point is the follow-up
d_reclassification.resolution_limited: (a) AND (b) but at least one (c) tolerance exceeded -> the 50 um base plateau is 'RESOLUTION-LIMITED': the v4 values supersede the v2 values for the quantities that moved, and the v2 plateau (Delta/lambda_D 3.17, on the CIC threshold) is recorded as under-resolved - a valid recorded outcome

acceptance.declared: predeclared before the launch; evaluated by `run.py assess` against reference_run.quantities; the verdict is one of the outcome values below and is recorded in assessment.json (results-only commit)

stopping_rule.fail_closed: runtime omega_pe dt gate (0.2), v2.0.3 window-mode peak-node Debye gate (hard pi cells per lambda_D on the 400000-step interval-averaged peak, once the window is complete), grid-heating triad hard drift bounds (S, T_e,dense, omega_pe dt drifts >= 0.25 after one transit) and the v2.0.3 windowed residual-power bound (trailing-400000-step ledger residual >= 5 % of the electrode work, one-sided, from the first complete window), one-cell Courant crossing, Poisson residual contract, neutral inventory exhaustion or ceiling violation: PIC2DStabilityError / triad stop ends the run with the artifacts written

grid_heating_triad.note: v1.4 triad drift members (soft 5 % = plateau precondition; hard 25 % after one transit) + v2.0.3 windowed residual-power hard gate (one-sided, 5 % of the electrode work over the trailing 400000 steps, from the first complete window); the cumulative ratio is recorded as the witness with its 10 % bound as a plateau precondition only. Calibration: the v2 base window ratios were -12.7 % (seed window) rising monotonically to -0.2 % at the plateau (max +0.37 %); seed-b -12.8 -> -1.5 %; w-0.7 -12.7 -> -4.2 %; attempt 8 crossed +5 % at ~3.1 us and reached +54.8 %

stopping_rule.ignition_check: the seed and injection are the ones that ignited v2 attempt 2 (and seed-b, w-0.7): S growing and N_e rising by ~1 us with n_g heading toward ~3e19; NO adjustment is allowed under this preregistration - a non-ignition is a recorded outcome of the refinement, not a reason to relaunch
stopping_rule.plateau: relative drift < 5 % over the trailing 20 % of the elapsed simulated time for the discharge current, the plasma electron count AND the neutral density (linear fit, drift = slope x window / |mean|), evaluated at every checkpoint; may only be declared after >= 3 ion transit times (3 x 2.4 us = 7.2 us = 5 142 858 steps); additionally the grid-heating triad must be inside its soft bounds (plateau.triad_soft_ok) AND the window-mode peak-Debye soft margin must hold (plateau.peak_debye_soft_ok: trailing-window Delta/lambda_D at the peak <= 2.5) - the v2 base rule plus the v2.0.3 preconditions
stopping_rule.wall_budget_note: 24 h cumulative over resumes (run_state.json): the a-priori 3-transit time is 13.4 h (attempt-8 table 13.1-14.0 h) and the v2 verdict fell at 3.2 transits (14.3 h at 9.4 ms/step); 24 h = 1.7x margin on the a-priori cost; the preflight-measured ms/step is recorded in preflight.json and the README before the launch. A budget stop without a plateau is a recorded outcome (resumable, but a resume is a new session under the same identity, disclosed)
